content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] without display and no memory card, but the software is installed in the device. If I insert a copy-protected card before powering up, what happens to the program originally stored in the device? Is the program still available inside, or can I only use it with this card inserted from now on?

[product_name] can only run a single program at a time. If you insert a card and power up, the current program will be replaced with the one from the inserted card. It's similar to transferring a new program from a PC.
I understand this. My question is: after I remove a copy-protected memory card, does the program stay in the device?

No, once you take out the protected card, the [product_name] contains no program—unlike with an unprotected card. You can only run the program while the protected card is inserted, which prevents copying the program onto another (empty) card.

Hello, if I copy a protected SD card to another SD card using my PC and put it into the device, will it work? I tried formatting and using the same card, and it worked, so the actual copy protection doesn't seem effective. Please advise, as this is very important to me. Thanks!

Hi, just to share: I thought about generating a random number automatically with every PLC run, so there's a new password each time. Anyone who wants to log in must contact us for the password. This method uses 25 blocks, which does provide protection, but I can't use those blocks for other functions now.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have questions about how copy protection works in [product_name] devices, especially regarding program persistence and security when using copy-protected cards. There's uncertainty about program availability after card removal and concerns over the effectiveness of the protection when copying via PC. Some users explore custom solutions, suggesting dissatisfaction with the default protection features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want strong program protection—so that once a copy-protected card is used, the program can't be accessed or copied without the card, and they expect the built-in protection to be reliable and secure.
